# ---- the library's Greatness (scope: a Kehillah leader): every work his
# community holds, weighted by its standing in his rite, between
# kehillah_lib_greatness_min and kehillah_lib_greatness_max.
kehillah_bd_library_works_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { primary_title ?= { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } } }
		if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos >= 9 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_canon }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 8 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_authoritative }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 7 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_esteemed }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 6 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_celebrated }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 5 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_popular }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 4 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_obscure }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 1 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_banned }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos = 0 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_anathema }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { primary_title ?= { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } } }
		if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta >= 9 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_canon }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta = 8 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_authoritative }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta = 7 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_esteemed }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta = 6 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_celebrated }
		else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta = 5 } add = kehillah_lib_greatness_popular }
